alt: A 0.15 kg ball hits a wall at +20 m/s (momentum +3.0 kg m/s) and rebounds at −15 m/s (−2.25 kg m/s). The change in momentum is −5.25 kg m/s, an impulse of 5.25 N s away from the wall; over 0.010 s the average force is 525 N.
caption: A rebound reverses the velocity, so the change in momentum is the sum of the two sizes.

alt: A 0.40 kg trolley moving right at 5.0 m/s meets a 0.60 kg trolley moving left at 2.0 m/s and they stick together. Total momentum before is 2.0 − 1.2 = 0.80 kg m/s, so afterwards the 1.00 kg pair moves at 0.80 m/s to the right. Kinetic energy falls from 6.2 J to 0.32 J.
caption: Total momentum before equals total momentum after; signs show direction.

alt: Left: 60 kg and 40 kg skaters at rest push apart; the 40 kg skater moves at 1.5 m/s, so the 60 kg skater moves at 1.0 m/s the opposite way and the total stays zero. Right: a 2.0 kg trolley at 3.0 m/s hits a stationary 4.0 kg trolley, which moves off at 2.0 m/s; the 2.0 kg trolley bounces back at 1.0 m/s.
caption: Starting from rest, the momenta after are equal and opposite.

after: ## Resultant force and rate of change of momentum
alt: A 5.0 kg head moving at 14 m/s has a change in momentum of 70 kg m/s when stopped. Against a hard dashboard in 0.010 s the force is 7000 N; with an airbag over 0.10 s it is 700 N. The bars are to scale. Longer stopping time, same change in momentum, smaller force.
caption: Same change in momentum over ten times the time: one tenth of the force.
